name: Neteuro Cookie Consent & Compliance
author: neteuro

sections.description:
Neteuro Cookie Consent & Compliance is a complete WordPress plugin for cookie consent management and GDPR/RGPD compliance.

Main features:

  • Customizable cookie banner with multiple layouts
  • Consent category management (necessary, preferences, statistics, marketing)
  • Google Consent Mode v2
  • Automatic script and iframe blocking
  • Automatic scanner for cookies, scripts and iframes
  • Per-cookie service management and automatic association with real services
  • Services Visibility in Banner
  • Service Grouping by Category
  • Services Dashboard Statistics
  • Enhanced Service Reporting
  • Granular Consent Architecture
  • Service Blocking Architecture
  • Granular Service Consent
  • Service-Level Preferences
  • Service Consent Analytics
  • Service-Level Blocking
  • Granular Script Blocking
  • Granular Iframe Blocking
  • Cookie Cleanup
  • Consent Revocation Cleanup
  • Known Cookie Removal
  • Google Consent Mode v2
  • Google Analytics Consent Signals
  • Google Ads Consent Signals
  • Google Tag Manager Compatibility
  • Vendor Transparency
  • Data Processor Registry
  • Vendor Privacy Information
  • Advanced Consent Analytics
  • Consent Trends
  • Service Analytics
  • Vendor Analytics
  • Auto Cookie Policy Generator
  • Dynamic Policy Builder
  • Automatic Policy Updates
  • Geo Rules EU / Non-EU
  • Region-aware Consent
  • Privacy-safe Geo Analytics
  • Banner A/B Testing
  • Banner Optimization
  • Consent Optimization
  • CMP Interoperability
  • Cookie Inventory Manager
  • Scanner & Classification Engine v2
  • Compliance Audit Wizard
  • Hardening & consistency improvements
  • Improved PDF reports
  • Automatic monitoring
  • Anonymous consent logs
  • Compliance Score
  • Multisite compatible

Architecture

  • NCCB Core — public API (NCCB_* classes, nccb/v1 REST, nccb_* hooks and options)
  • Single technical prefix across PHP, JavaScript, CSS, AJAX, cron and database tables

Features

Services Detection Engine

  • Pre-configured system service catalog
  • Patterns for cookies, scripts, iframes and domains
  • Automatic detected_service association in scan reports
  • Custom service management in admin
  • Custom service import/export
  • Shortcode [nccb_cookie_services]

Services Visibility

Display detected services directly inside the cookie preferences interface, grouped by category.

  • Optional services grouping
  • Category-based service display
  • Collapsible service lists
  • Transparency improvements

Granular Consent Architecture

Internal architecture that powers optional service-level consent and blocking.

  • Service consent storage table and API
  • Service blocking architecture and flags
  • Service-level consent payload handling
  • Works together with category-based consent

Granular Service Consent

Allow visitors to enable or disable individual services inside each consent category.

  • Service-level preferences
  • Service-level consent logs
  • Service acceptance analytics
  • Category-to-service inheritance

Service-Level Blocking

Block or allow scripts and iframes based on the visitor’s consent for each individual service.

  • Service-level script blocking
  • Service-level iframe blocking
  • Category fallback
  • Pattern-based blocking
  • Optional activation

Cookie Cleanup

Automatically remove known cookies when consent is withdrawn.

  • Service-based cleanup
  • Consent revocation cleanup
  • Reject-all cleanup
  • Cleanup statistics
  • Optional activation

Google Consent Mode v2

Optional support for Google’s Consent Mode v2 based on the visitor’s consent choices.

The plugin generates consent signals locally from the configured consent categories and service preferences.

The plugin itself does not connect to or send data to Google services.

Any communication with Google services occurs directly between the visitor’s browser and the Google services configured by the website owner, according to the visitor’s consent choices.

  • Consent Mode v2 support
  • Analytics consent signals
  • Ads consent signals
  • Google Tag Manager compatibility
  • Granular service support

Vendor Transparency

Maintain a registry of data processors and associate them with detected services.

  • Vendor registry
  • Privacy policies
  • DPA tracking
  • EU / Non-EU classification
  • Vendor reporting

Advanced Consent Analytics

Analyse consent behaviour across categories, services and vendors.

  • Consent KPIs
  • Time trends
  • Service analytics
  • Vendor analytics
  • CSV export
  • PDF analytics

Auto Cookie Policy Generator

Generate a dynamic cookie policy based on detected services, vendors and cookie categories.

  • Automatic policy generation
  • Editable content
  • Vendor integration
  • Cookie tables
  • PDF export
  • Automatic updates

Geo Rules

Apply region-aware consent rules without storing precise visitor location.

  • EU / Non-EU rules
  • Privacy-safe region detection
  • Region-aware defaults
  • Geo consent analytics
  • No precise location storage

Banner A/B Testing

Test banner variants and optimize consent performance.

  • Variant testing
  • Consent optimization
  • Winner detection
  • Consent lift analysis
  • Geo-aware testing

CMP Interoperability

Expose consent information through PHP, JavaScript and REST APIs.

  • Public Consent API
  • JS Events
  • REST Endpoints
  • Third-party integrations
  • CMP readiness

Scanner & Classification Engine

Enhanced scanner with automatic technology detection, confidence scoring and resource classification.

  • Technology Detection (GTM, GA4, Meta Pixel, Clarity, etc.)
  • Confidence Scoring (0–100)
  • Automatic Classification
  • Domain and pattern matching
  • Enhanced scan reports

Cookie Inventory Manager

Centralize detected and declared cookies in a unified inventory with service and vendor associations.

  • Unified cookie inventory table
  • Cookie review workflow (approve, ignore, restore)
  • Service and vendor mapping
  • CSV export
  • Policy, PDF and compliance score integration

Hardening

Technical improvements, security hardening, consistency updates and internal refactoring.

  • Compliance score display consistency
  • REST endpoint documentation and rate limiting
  • Technical diagnostics
  • Legacy code cleanup

Banner & Consent

  • Responsive banner with multiple positions
  • Floating button to reopen preferences
  • Category consent model with automatic fallback

Scanner & Monitoring

  • Automatic site scan
  • Detection of cookies, scripts, iframes and services
  • Scheduled monitoring with email alerts

Reports

  • Detailed scan reports
  • Detected services section with metrics
  • Professional PDF audit
  • JSON export

Shortcodes

  • [nccb_cookie_policy] — Cookie policy page
  • [nccb_cookie_table] — Declared cookies table
  • [nccb_cookie_settings] — Button to reopen preferences
  • [nccb_cookie_services] — Configured cookie services list
  • [nccb_vendors] — Data processor list with privacy policies
  • [nccb_generated_policy] — Automatically generated cookie policy

Compliance Audit Wizard

Guided workflow to configure, review and document cookie compliance.

External Services

This plugin does not connect to, request data from, or send data to any external service.

Domain names found in page content, such as Google Tag Manager, Google Analytics, Google Maps, Meta Pixel and Cloudflare, are used only as local detection and classification signatures. Detection and classification are performed entirely on the WordPress website.

The plugin may manage consent for third-party services already installed or configured by the website owner. When a visitor grants consent, the visitor’s browser may communicate directly with those third-party services. These communications are initiated by the website’s configured third-party scripts, not by this plugin.

Google Analytics

This plugin can locally detect Google Analytics scripts present on the website and classify them for consent management purposes.

The plugin itself does not connect to or send data to Google Analytics.

If Google Analytics has been installed or configured by the website owner, the visitor’s browser may communicate directly with Google after the applicable consent has been granted.

Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms

Third-Party Libraries

This plugin bundles FPDF for PDF report generation. See THIRD-PARTY-LICENSES.txt in the plugin package for license details. The included FPDF library file declares version 1.9 (2026-05-31) by Olivier Plathey.

Roadmap

Planned

  • Advanced scanner improvements
  • Optional TCF research module
  • Enterprise export tools
sections.installation:
1. Upload the neteuro-cookie-consent-compliance folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu
  3. Configure under Settings → Neteuro Cookie Consent & Compliance
  4. Run a scan under Neteuro Cookie Consent & Compliance → Reports or on the Scanner tab
  5. Optional: configure services under Neteuro Cookie Consent & Compliance → Services
sections.faq:
Does the plugin change the current category-based consent model?

Category-based consent remains the primary model. Optional service-level consent and blocking can be enabled when configured; otherwise category consent continues to apply.

Is the plugin compatible with multisite?

Yes. Each site in the network has its own tables and settings.

Is existing data preserved during updates?

Yes for normal updates within the same identifier scheme (nccb_*). Version 13.0.0 is a full identifier rename; previous local tables and options using older prefixes are not deleted by the plugin and are not auto-migrated.
